homeV5ClaimTranslations.interpretation: This is a spatial-temporal narrative closure, not a poster surface and not a generic animated footer.
homeV5ClaimTranslations.recommendation: Reproduce the normalized layer placement, reveal/state-swap sequence, three exact loop periods and loop-only pause control as one indivisible contract.
suitableFor: Home page-closing illustration before the structural footer
allowedTransformations: narrow-layout height expansion when required to keep every foreground layer legible
